## Codebase Intelligence for scenegrid-console (Repowise)

Last indexed: 2026-11-26 (commit 4c6d8d3).

For any question about this codebase, call a Repowise tool first (get_answer for how/where/why questions, search_codebase for an identifier, get_context for callers or a file).
- Before a rename: `get_context(targets=["<symbol>"], include=["references"])`.
- Before changing how a file works: `get_why(targets=["<file>"])`, as recorded decisions govern some files.
- Noisy commands (tests, builds): `repowise distill <cmd>`.
- Settings: `repowise config list`, then `config explain <key>`.
- Record a decision you reasoned out: `repowise decision add --help`.

## OpenWiki

This repository has a generated `openwiki/` evidence index. It is optional just-in-time context, not required startup reading.

- Treat source code and tests as authoritative. A brief's unknowns and review items are verification gaps, not automatic requirements.
- Prefer the narrowest quiet validation that proves the changed behavior. Preserve complete failure output.

The scheduled OpenWiki GitHub Actions workflow refreshes the repository wiki. Do not hand-edit generated OpenWiki pages unless explicitly asked; prefer updating source code/docs and letting OpenWiki regenerate.

## Keep the Why

This project records the reasoning behind its code with the Keep the Why
skill (https://keepthewhy.com) — the `.keep-the-why` file at the project
root is its config. Before doing anything else in a session, whatever the
first request is about, load the skill: in Claude Code, invoke the
`keep-the-why` skill (Skill tool); in any other agent, read
`.agents/skills/keep-the-why/SKILL.md` and follow it, including the
`references/*.md` files it points to for the situation at hand.
